narrative_purpose: Puts the vent scenario's central bind in one frame: the same long molecule fragmenting in the hot plume where the energy is, and surviving intact in the cool still water where nothing drives it to form.
subject: A frame divided down the middle into two matched panels. In the left panel, a rising column of hot shimmering fluid full of turbulent swirls, and within it four long chains of linked round beads are coming apart — each chain broken into two or three short pieces with loose single beads scattering away from the break points into the current. In the right panel, still dark cool water, and within it four intact chains of the same linked beads, each one whole and gently coiled, hanging motionless. The bead chains are identical in construction on both sides so they read as the same kind of molecule.
scene: Two adjacent bodies of water from the same vent system: turbulent hot outflow on the left, quiet cold ocean on the right, separated by a soft vertical transition rather than a hard line.
camera: A flat straight-on view into both panels at matched scale and distance, no perspective, so the comparison is direct.
light: The left panel lit by a warm amber shimmer carried in the rising fluid itself, hot and unstable-looking. The right panel almost unlit, cool faint teal rim light picking out the intact coiled chains against near-black water.
palette: Left panel warm ember-amber and magenta in the turbulent fluid with the broken fragments picked out in magenta; right panel void-indigo water with the whole chains in living teal. The warm and cool halves must be immediately distinguishable.
style: Painterly naturalist comparison plate, hand-painted, matched panels in the manner of a field study showing one specimen under two conditions.
detail_level: Crisp on all the bead chains and their break points in both panels; the surrounding fluid rendered loosely, turbulent on the left and flat on the right.
composition: Perfect left-right symmetry of layout with the chains occupying the same positions in both halves, a soft vertical seam down the centre, plain dark space at the top of each panel for overlaid callouts.
consistency_notes: The bead chains must be single strands, not double helices, and must be visibly the same construction in both panels so the only difference is whether they are whole. The divider is a soft transition, not a drawn frame or border.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no chemical notation, no double helix, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style, no drawn panel borders or frames
